# String instructions

The `.string` stack holds text. Indices count characters, not bytes, and an index outside a string is clamped into it rather than refused.

## The stack's own instructions

Every stack has the same family for copying, deleting, reordering and measuring its items; see <doc:StackInstructions>. On `.string` they are `stringDeepDup`, `stringDeleteAtDepth`, `stringDup`, `stringDupItems`, `stringDupTimes`, `stringFlush`, `stringPop`, `stringPopItems`, `stringRot`, `stringShove`, `stringStackDepth`, `stringStackIsEmpty`, `stringSwap`, `stringYank`, `stringYankDup`.
